scope: Local overclaim evidence preparation only. No verified adverse state, ownership, mandate, provider form, contact, amendment, relinquishment, upload, disposition or receipt. Preserve contrary evidence and original share conventions.

overclaim/work ID.next_step: Map the exact existing overclaim and work identifiers with their observed state. A local label does not prove the current provider state.

competing claims.next_step: Preserve all relevant competing and contrary evidence, claimant context, source share conventions, territory and periods. Do not infer the correct allocation or reduce claims to a total.
competing claims.basis: The MLC describes conflicting reported shares; preservation and non-adjudication follow the local resolution contract.

supporting documents.next_step: Map authentic supporting documents and their exact source versions. Retain material contrary evidence; do not invent consent or infer mandate from login access.

exact selected remedy.next_step: Map only the existing requested remedy and its scope. Contacting claimants, amending shares, relinquishing shares and uploading documents require distinct matching authority; preparation performs none.

overclaim_review.selected_remedy: Verify the exact requested remedy, affected work/claims, periods and original disclosure against the existing action. Ordinary claims and technical rejections stay in their registration workflows.
overclaim_review.contact_authority: Review specific recipients, content and channel authority before any contact. This packet sends no message and does not infer authority to contact claimants.
overclaim_review.amendment_authority: Review exact requested share changes and their authority separately. Do not reduce a claim to satisfy a total or infer ownership from reported collection shares.
overclaim_review.relinquishment_authority: Review any relinquishment as a separate consequential action; preparing evidence neither waives rights nor authorizes removal of shares.
overclaim_review.upload_authority: Review each document, necessary disclosure, actual recipients and upload authority separately. No document is sent or uploaded by preparation.
overclaim_review.case_disposition: Preserve actual provider case disposition and granted versus requested scope separately; local preparation does not resolve or adjudicate the dispute.
overclaim_review.share_readback: Verify any exact share change on the actual work independently of a submission or case closure, retaining previous claims and source versions.
overclaim_review.financial_effect: Keep accounting adjustment, payable eligibility, remittance and received cash separate from a case or share correction. No current balance or recovery is inferred.

review_basis: The MLC documents contact, share amendment/relinquishment and supporting-document routes. Separate authority, contrary evidence and outcome checks preserve the local resolution contract; no provider schema is invented.
remaining_account_checks: Inspect the current Member Overclaims Tool and actual adverse state, account role and mandate before any separately authorized step.
A complete mapping is not filing-ready, a granted remedy, share readback or financial evidence.
